sourceAudit.method: PE normal and delay import closure; exact binary .BUILDINFO/PKGBUILD hash matching; every recipe source payload SHA or pinned Git commit/tree checked; incorporated static/header code reviewed; Rust lock checksums and logged update archived.
sourceAudit.staticInputs: shaderc incorporates glslang16.3.0/SPIRV-Tools363; older Tools350 optimizer headers retained for glslang; libplacebo includes fast_float,inline xxhash,GLAD-generated headers; Vulkan/AMF/NV/OpenCL interfaces and FFmpeg dlfcn shim retained.
sourceAudit.exclusions: Windows OS libraries; build executables and their test/CLI-only dependencies; optional dlopen plugins unused by CyberRoom; compiler/toolchain executables. GCC runtime and full mingw-w64 source are retained through gcc/winpthreads packages. No standalone mpv/ffmpeg executable or Python scripts are distributed.
